about: Audit of HomeLibrary site/js/data.js (642 books, built 2026-10-18) against Open Library, 23 Oct 2026. Google Books could not be used: its anonymous daily quota was exhausted (HTTP 429). Open Library found 516 of 566 ISBNs. Every flag below was checked by hand; Open Library's own errors are listed separately so they aren't acted on.

checkedFine_openLibraryWrong.title: Army Without Banners
checkedFine_openLibraryWrong.note: Open Library says 'Living Stone' (Handheld Press); a library catalogue (TUM) confirms this ISBN is Army Without Banners, Handheld Classics 36.

checkedFine_openLibraryWrong.title: The Book of Beginnings
checkedFine_openLibraryWrong.note: Open Library says 'Meeting Point'; booksellers confirm The Book of Beginnings, HarperCollins 2023.

checkedFine_openLibraryWrong.title: DK Eyewitness Top 10 Delhi
checkedFine_openLibraryWrong.note: Same book (Top 10 Delhi); only the title wording differs.

worthACheck.title: Paper Towns
worthACheck.note: 978-1-101 is a Penguin US ebook range and the date (2008-10-16) is the US ebook's; not found on Open Library. If she owns a paperback, the ISBN is probably wrong.

worthACheck.title: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them: The Original Screenplay
worthACheck.note: This is the Pottermore ebook ISBN (Libib's description says 'ebook edition'). A printed copy will have a Little, Brown/Sphere ISBN (UK hardback probably 9781408708989).

worthACheck.title: Becoming
worthACheck.note: Added by hand; not found on Open Library or by web search. Check against the book.

worthACheck.title: The Magician's Apprentice
worthACheck.note: Valid Little, Brown number but no record found anywhere; her other Canavans are UK Orbit (978-1-841...).
Not on Open Library but plausible (small presses, self-published, new): 46 others, listed in notFound in this file.

fix.title: New Term, Summer Term, Winter Term, Secrets, Fun and Games at Malory Towers; Goodbye, Malory Towers; Kitty at St Clare's

years.title: The Saga of Darren Shan 4–12 (nine books)
years.note: The ISBNs are the 2001–2004 first paperbacks; 2009-02-05 is a reissue date. Fine if her copies are the 2009 covers.

years.title: Foundation
years.note: ISBN 0586010807 is the Panther/Grafton paperback (Open Library 1968); 1994 is probably a reprint.

years.title: The Colour of Magic
years.note: Corgi paperback first 1985; Open Library's copy is 1990. Probably fine.

years.title: Secret Seven Centenary Editions
years.note: Fine: Hodder issued them 1996–97 for the 1997 centenary (Open Library's 'first published' dates for these are wrong).

years.title: Old Book Collection dates ending -01-01
years.libib: e.g. Claudine at St Clare's 1944, The Twins at St Clare's 1943
years.note: All on or after the first edition; look like her own estimates. Nothing wrong found.
